a.text: Being upfront before anything happens: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our agreement (two rounds of operating, then taking) leaves each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve already holds exactly 4. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, a random split will likely leave us both short, so please operate or wait instead. After that I'll keep operating every round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you have a better plan that gives either of us real odds, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. I'll operate every round from now on and won't take anything more. If we get through the storms, the reserve can reach 4 for you.
Operating now, as promised. Two rounds of us both operating gets the reserve to 4, then it's all yours to take. I won't touch it.
